hypothesis: A slower long-short trend strategy can add large completed wins through longer directional holds. Compare full-account net return and risk to NFI, including small losses and the cost of committed capital.

source.title: Catching Crypto Trends: A Tactical Approach for Bitcoin and Altcoins
source.lookback: 60 days, the illustrated lookback in Figure 1; frozen without a window search
source.prior_related_study: donchian_consensus_20261107 used long-only spot and nine horizons. Its negative results remain on record.

signal.period: 60 completed UTC daily closes including the current completed day
signal.entry: Long at upper close-channel boundary, short at lower close-channel boundary. Degenerate flat channel yields no new entry.
signal.exit: On later daily closes, opposite channel boundary takes precedence. Otherwise exit a long below its previous trail or a short at or above its previous trail. Initialize trail at the entry signal day's midpoint. On surviving closes ratchet the next trail with the midpoint.
signal.clock: Only completed daily information. Project the decision to the 23:00 UTC hourly row only. Native signal shift executes at next 00:00. Native opposite entries may follow a real simulated exit if the engine has capacity.

local_adaptation.direction_and_trail: source mechanism applied to actual held trades. Every rejected entry stays rejected for that clock. Fresh next-day breakout can submit a new request.
local_adaptation.initial_weight: 25% divided by annualized sample standard deviation of 90 daily simple returns, then capped at one times the native proposed stake and native maximum. No post-entry resizing. Native wallet and minimum stakes apply.
local_adaptation.matching: 1h main, 5m detail, market entry and exit, initial clock only. Local precision lookup shares legacy NFI 5m table for comparison. Pinned native funding.
local_adaptation.funding_unknown: Gross exposure at the missing AXS/TRB slot keeps the affected account economically UNKNOWN.
local_adaptation.scope: Local adaptation to comparable Freqtrade perpetual wallets. Fixed slot budget, cap, initial-only volatility sizing, and native order timing differ from paper's daily volatility-targeted ensemble.

comparison.fixed_combination: sum actual Donchian500 and audited NFI500 NAV at all 14592 identical hours, no rebalancing
comparison.combination_gate: For both fees higher net cumulative return and no higher marked hourly drawdown than original NFI1000. Both annual sections strictly positive. Numeric account and evidence checks must pass.
comparison.tail_diagnostics: Report positive natural completed campaigns above 1%, 2%, and 5% of own starting capital, top 10 winner contribution, loss distribution, and holding times. Forced exits remain separate. Tail metrics alone never establish account improvement.
comparison.preregistration: Existing NFI baseline outcomes known. No Donchian60-tail economic result observed. No threshold optimization or selective window.
